svg.title: Sequence diagram — AI assistance (2/2): the public space finder

g.text: Sequence diagram — AI assistance (2/2): the public space finder
1. understand: the model reads the request
2. search: a database query, no model
3. reply: the model describes only the rows found
PUBLIC filter: is_published, status AVAILABLE, map coordinates set.
The model never selects data: an injected prompt can change
what it says, never what it can read. Throttled: 12 requests/min.
